summary: The three live families use plain Go definitions with canonical manifests and generated public projections, without a parts catalog or composition compiler. Common runtime action and payload implementations remain shared. Parts-only tests retire with assembly. Work has no size classification, model, inputs, proofs or size-specific review gate. Live steps, independent review, blocking-finding admission, current-subject proof, snapshot-backed upgrades and retired-size event refusal remain.
title: Plain workflow definitions without work-item size classification
